snippet.title: Official Alaris Trailer
snippet.description:
“Alaris” is a fantasy-romance visual novel inspired by the myths of Dragon and Fae. Follow our main character who, after a dangerous run-in with a mysterious stranger, discovers the existence of another realm, whose people have been lost to history. Play as a renowned healer, whose role may be crucial in this new world, as you unravel secrets, discover yourself, and perhaps even find love.

Song by Peter Reid Jones
Trailer by Axeleraey
